episode.title: Restore persisted conversation context when starting a new session
episode.before: At parent 1098b428e6e118be2e4ebb49a3dd2b14ae79e50e, coder initialization accepted optional in-memory completed messages but otherwise initialized an empty completed-message list. Although chat transcripts were persisted as Markdown, startup did not read or reconstruct that transcript, so a restarted session lacked prior conversational context. History summarization always used the model-defined history budget and could pass an arbitrarily large old-message head to the summarizer.
episode.after: At merge commit 45b2ba8a1056bb27f197b01d08f3ea0d4d92b668, initialization preserves explicitly supplied completed messages, but when none exist it reads the configured chat-history file, parses persisted user and assistant turns, installs them as completed messages, and starts background compaction. Startup announcements report restored history. A command-line token-budget override is propagated to the summarizer, and the summarization path selects the newest portion of an old-message head that fits within the summarizer model's input capacity.
episode.diff: Relative to first parent 1098b428, four implementation files changed: aider/args.py adds --max-chat-history-tokens; aider/main.py passes that option into coder construction; aider/coders/base_coder.py selects the configured or model-default budget, conditionally restores persisted history when no completed messages were supplied, starts summarization, and announces restoration; aider/history.py extracts Markdown-to-message parsing into ChatSummary and bounds the old-message subset submitted for summarization. No test file changed in the first-parent diff.

evidence_units.claim: The pinned ref is merge commit 45b2ba8a with first parent 1098b428 and subject 'Restore prior chat history on launch'.

Before the change, coder initialization converted an absent completed-message argument into an empty list and constructed ChatSummary from the model default, but performed no persisted-history read or restoration.

After the change, coder initialization uses an explicit history-token budget when supplied, otherwise the model default; if completed messages are empty, it reads io.chat_history_file, parses nonempty content, assigns the reconstructed messages, and invokes summarize_start().

The Markdown parser ignores transcript headings, quoted/tool output, and slash-command headings; it emits user messages from ordinary '#### ' headings and buffered assistant text as assistant messages.

When summarizing an oversized history head, the implementation walks backward from the newest old messages and retains only a subset within the summarizer model's maximum input tokens minus a 512-token reserve.
The command-line parser defines --max-chat-history-tokens with a null default, and the main construction path passes its value to the coder.
The startup announcement list includes 'Restored previous conversation history.' whenever completed messages are present after initialization.
The first-parent implementation diff changes only aider/args.py, aider/coders/base_coder.py, aider/history.py, and aider/main.py; it contains no test-file modification.
The complete first-parent patch passes Git's whitespace-error check.
The before/after diff adds persisted-history restoration without replacing explicitly supplied completed messages because the file read is guarded by an empty completed-message predicate.

candidate_atomics.name: reconstruct-persisted-conversation-turns
candidate_atomics.description: Convert a persisted human-readable transcript into structured user and assistant messages while excluding transcript metadata and command/tool-output sections.

semantic_action.intent: Recover conversational turns from persisted session text so they can re-enter runtime context.
semantic_action.pre_state: A nonempty persisted transcript contains headings, conversational text, and potentially metadata, command, or quoted-output lines.
semantic_action.post_state: The transcript is represented as an ordered list of user and assistant message objects, with recognized non-conversational sections omitted.
semantic_action.validation: Direct implementation inspection establishes each parsing rule and emitted role; no dedicated automated parser test was added in the resolution diff.

candidate_atomics.name: restore-history-only-when-runtime-context-is-empty
candidate_atomics.description: Hydrate completed conversation state from persistent storage during initialization only when the caller did not provide completed messages, then initiate compaction.

semantic_action.intent: Resume prior conversational state after process restart without overwriting state explicitly supplied by a caller.
semantic_action.pre_state: Runtime initialization has either caller-supplied completed messages or an empty completed-message state, and a configured history source may contain prior turns.
semantic_action.post_state: Caller-supplied completed messages remain authoritative; otherwise nonempty persisted history populates completed state and enters the existing summarization lifecycle.
semantic_action.validation: The initialization guard, read, assignment, and summarize_start call directly establish precedence and restoration flow; the change contains no behavioral regression test.

candidate_atomics.name: bound-restored-history-compaction
candidate_atomics.description: Apply a configurable soft history budget and cap the old-message subset sent to the summarizer according to the summarizer model's input capacity.

semantic_action.intent: Prevent restored or accumulated history from exceeding configured history and summarizer-input limits.
semantic_action.pre_state: Conversation history exceeds its soft budget and the old-message head may itself be larger than the summarizer model can accept.
semantic_action.post_state: The runtime uses the requested or model-default history budget, and the summarization request retains the newest old messages that fit beneath the model input limit with reserved capacity.
semantic_action.validation: Static inspection confirms option propagation and the token-accumulation cutoff; no changed test exercises boundary sizes or summarizer requests.

candidate_atomics.name: signal-restored-context-to-user
candidate_atomics.description: Expose restoration through the normal startup announcement channel when completed conversation state is present.

semantic_action.intent: Make resumed conversational state visible to the operator at session startup.
semantic_action.pre_state: Initialization has produced a nonempty completed-message state.
semantic_action.post_state: Startup status includes an explicit restored-history message.
semantic_action.validation: The announcement predicate and emitted text are directly visible in the implementation; no output assertion was added in the resolution diff.

candidate_workflows.name: resume-persisted-conversation-with-bounded-context
candidate_workflows.description: Restore conversational continuity at startup while preserving caller-provided state and bringing recovered history under the existing context-compaction policy.

workflow_graph.goal: Start a new process with usable prior conversational context without replacing explicit runtime state or exceeding context budgets.
workflow_graph.entry_state: A session is being initialized; completed messages may be absent, and a configured persisted transcript may contain earlier conversation turns.
workflow_graph.exit_state: Explicit completed state is preserved when present; otherwise persisted turns are reconstructed, scheduled for bounded compaction, and reported through startup status.
unresolved_or_deferred: No automated test changed with the implementation, so transcript edge cases, caller-state precedence, asynchronous compaction, and announcement behavior lack a commit-local behavioral oracle.

The standalone aider/history.py main function calls summarize_chat_history_markdown, which is not defined by ChatSummary at the pinned ref; this auxiliary path is not used by the production restoration call site and its intended status is unresolved.
The implementation does not distinguish history restored from disk from nonempty completed messages supplied by another caller when producing the restoration announcement.

unresolved_questions: No PR body, review discussion, status checks, or issue comments are available in the supplied GitHub evidence bundle.
No direct automated tests accompany the first-parent implementation diff; git diff --check validates patch hygiene only, not runtime restoration behavior.

The bounded summarization logic reverses and truncates the tokenized head before later calculating tail_tokens from sized[split_index:], leaving the exact recursive-budget behavior insufficiently validated at this ref.
